description: Read the branch-protection rule that applies to a branch (exact name or the glob that covers it): required checks, require_pr_run, required approvals, AI / human review, green gates, force-push / deletion, auto-merge; plus `merge_train` {on, batch_max, effective_batch_max, host_ceiling} — whether the merge train runs for the repository and how many armed PRs it tests together; plus `gate_test` {enabled, server_configured, state: on | disabled_in_settings | not_configured_on_server, details} — whether GateTest scans the repository (set it with merjax_update_repo gate_test_enabled). Read-only. Returns {protected: false, merge_train, gate_test} when no rule applies, else {protected: true, pattern, matched_by, required_checks, …, merge_train, gate_test}.

branch.description: Branch name (default: the repo's default branch)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: merjax_get_branch_protection
